body:
Does this happen on [Godot 4.7 dev 4](https://godotengine.org/download/archive/4.7-dev4/) and [Godot 4.7 dev 5](https://godotengine.org/download/archive/4.7-dev5/)?

These builds are my guesses as to when this issue potentially started happening, but if they both work fine, I'd appreciate it if you could try every 4.7 dev/beta/RC build and locate the exact one the issue happens.

> Does this happen on [Godot 4.7 dev 4](https://godotengine.org/download/archive/4.7-dev4/) and [Godot 4.7 dev 5](https://godotengine.org/download/archive/4.7-dev5/)?
> 
> These builds are my guesses as to when this issue potentially started happening, but if they both work fine, I'd appreciate it if you could try every 4.7 dev/beta/RC build and locate the exact one the issue happens.

Tested mostly all versions, here are the results:

Tests were done in the MRP

4.7 RC2 - Doesn't work
4.7 RC1 - Doesn't work

4.7 beta 5 - Doesn't work
4.7 beta 4 - Doesn't work
4.7 beta 3 - Doesn't work
4.7 beta 2 - Doesn't work
4.7 beta 1 - Doesn't work

4.7 dev5 - Doesn't work
4.7 dev4 - Works
4.7 dev3 - Works
4.7 dev2 - ?
4.7 dev1 - ?

dev2 and dev1 should probably work too

Thanks, this is very helpful. I have a feeling the Area Lights PR might have introduced this issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108219

Are you able to roll back the commit (to the one right before this PR was merged) and build Godot yourself to test it out?

(writing from a different account on a phone)

I am able to revert and compile the engine myself to test it. I can do it in a few hours

> Thanks, this is very helpful. I have a feeling the Area Lights PR might have introduced this issue: [#108219](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108219)
> 
> Are you able to roll back the commit (to the one right before this PR was merged) and build Godot yourself to test it out?

Can confirm it works fine with no errors on the commit before Area Lights PR was merged
added some aditional info to the first message with "EDIT:"

I tested 4.7 rc2 and master with a phone with an Adreno 640 GPU and I cannot reproduce any issues. So this must be a bug specific to the Adreno 660

No validation layer errors on android either

Reproducible on Adreno 650 (Poco F3) as well (tested rc2). > Seems like a driver bug. I'll try to determine which part of the shader is causing it tomorrow.

It would be in the area light code. So most likely in

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/area_lights_inc.glsl

Or

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6b1004bbebe112ab27804160933f78eb4959bca6/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/scene_forward_lights_inc.glsl#L958

One workaround to try would be to force enable `driver_workarounds.disable_ubershaders` on that device

Disabling ubershader does not fix it.

The function that's causing the issue seems to be `ltc_integrate_clipped_quad`

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/6b1004bbebe112ab27804160933f78eb4959bca6/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/area_lights_inc.glsl#L205-L217

It's working if any 2 of `integrate_edge` calls are removed. Definitely a compiler bug, no idea how to work it around.
@bruvzg Can you try lowering the SPIR-V version down to 1.3 just in case? This line here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/drivers/vulkan/rendering_shader_container_vulkan.cpp#L104

> Can you try lowering the SPIR-V version down to 1.3 just in case?

It's the same with 1.3.

> Does this work?

No, the same linker error. I have also tried to modify `ltc_integrate_clipped_quad` is various ways (replacing arrays with separate variables, adding extra operations in between calls, changing data types) but without any success.
Made a PR with this change https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120344

> Can you set this to 0? Does it fix both issues?

It's not fixing the missing geometry issue in my case.

> [@kekuyer228](https://github.com/kekuyer228) I have an idea for the other issue the PR doesn't fix.
> 
> Can you set this to 0? Does it fix both issues?
> 
> https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp#L64

I tried compiling with both PR and `#define RESPV_ONLY_INLINE_SHADERS_WITH_SPEC_CONSTANTS 0` at the same time. It didn't fix the issue

Building with just `#define RESPV_ONLY_INLINE_SHADERS_WITH_SPEC_CONSTANTS 0` also doesn't work
Were your earlier tests for both the 650 and 660, or just the 660? Unsure if they began at roughly the same time

> Were your earlier tests for both the 650 and 660, or just the 660? Unsure if they began at roughly the same time

Just 660. Tests for 650 are being done by @bruvzg

@kekuyer228 Hey, would you be able to make another test?

Change this line: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_mobile/render_forward_mobile.cpp#L3553
